note: DERIVED, not captured: the 403 of a secondary rate limit on a content-creating POST, shaped from GitHub's docs (rate limits and best practices: retry-after, no x-ratelimit-remaining of 0). Its message holds no `API rate limit exceeded`, so ADR-0107 keeps it a refusal.
